questions.stem: Does the function \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x + 5 & \text{if } x \le 1 \\ x - 5 & \text{if } x > 1 \end{cases}\) continuous at \(x = 1\) ?

hi.stem: क्या फलन \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x + 5 & \text{यदि } x \le 1 \\ x - 5 & \text{यदि } x > 1 \end{cases}\) \(x = 1\) पर संतत है ?
hi.solution:
\(x = 1\) पर: \(f(1) = 1 + 5 = 6\)।
बाएँ पक्ष की सीमा: \(\lim_{x \to 1^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^-} (x + 5) = 6\)।
दाएँ पक्ष की सीमा: \(\lim_{x \to 1^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^+} (x - 5) = -4\)।
बाएँ और दाएँ पक्ष की सीमाएँ बराबर नहीं हैं, अतः \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x)\) का अस्तित्व नहीं है। अतः \(f\), \(x = 1\) पर संतत नहीं है।

\(\frac{1}{y}\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{dx}\log x + \frac{y}{x}\)
\(\frac{dy}{dx}\left(\frac{1}{y} - \log x\right) = \frac{y}{x}\)
\(\frac{dy}{dx} \cdot \frac{1 - y\log x}{y} = \frac{y}{x}\)
\(x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y^2}{1 - y\log x}\)
इति सिद्धम्।

questions.stem:
For two invertible matrices A and B of order \(n\), prove that
\((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\).

hi.stem: कोटि \(n\) के दो व्युत्क्रमणीय आव्यूहों A और B के लिये सिद्ध कीजिए कि \((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\).
hi.solution:
चूँकि \(A\) और \(B\) व्युत्क्रमणीय हैं, अतः \(|A| \ne 0\) तथा \(|B| \ne 0\)। तब \(|AB| = |A||B| \ne 0\), अतः \(AB\) कोटि \(n\) का व्युत्क्रमणीय आव्यूह है।
अब
\((AB)(B^{-1}A^{-1}) = A(BB^{-1})A^{-1} = AIA^{-1} = AA^{-1} = I\)
\((B^{-1}A^{-1})(AB) = B^{-1}(A^{-1}A)B = B^{-1}IB = B^{-1}B = I\)
अतः \(B^{-1}A^{-1}\) को \(AB\) से किसी भी ओर गुणा करने पर तत्समक आव्यूह प्राप्त होता है। आव्यूह के व्युत्क्रम की परिभाषा से (जो अद्वितीय होता है), \((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\)।
इति सिद्धम्।

*हल PYQ Vault द्वारा: यूपी बोर्ड उत्तर कुंजी प्रकाशित नहीं करता।*

questions._flag: The English word "prove" is broken in the print ("pro c"); completed from the Hindi सिद्ध कीजिए.
questions.solution:
Since \(A\) and \(B\) are invertible, \(|A| \ne 0\) and \(|B| \ne 0\). Then \(|AB| = |A||B| \ne 0\), so \(AB\) is an invertible matrix of order \(n\).
Now
\((AB)(B^{-1}A^{-1}) = A(BB^{-1})A^{-1} = AIA^{-1} = AA^{-1} = I\)
\((B^{-1}A^{-1})(AB) = B^{-1}(A^{-1}A)B = B^{-1}IB = B^{-1}B = I\)
So \(B^{-1}A^{-1}\) multiplied by \(AB\) on either side gives the identity matrix. By the definition of the inverse of a matrix (which is unique), \((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\).
Hence proved.

Since \(f'(x) > 0\) throughout \((\pi, 2\pi)\), the function \(f(x) = \cos x\) is increasing (strictly) in \((\pi, 2\pi)\).

questions.stem: Does the relation defined by \(R = \{(x, y) : y \text{ is divisible by } x\}\) on the set \(A = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\}\), an equivalence relation ?
questions.solution:
Here \((x, y) \in R\) means \(x\) divides \(y\). On \(A = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\}\):
\(R = \{(1, 1), (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 4), (1, 5), (1, 6), (2, 2), (2, 4), (2, 6), (3, 3), (3, 6), (4, 4), (5, 5), (6, 6)\}\)
**Reflexive:** every number divides itself, so \((x, x) \in R\) for every \(x \in A\). Hence \(R\) is reflexive.
**Symmetric:** \((1, 2) \in R\) since 2 is divisible by 1, but \((2, 1) \notin R\) since 1 is not divisible by 2. Hence \(R\) is not symmetric.
**Transitive:** let \((x, y) \in R\) and \((y, z) \in R\). Then \(y = kx\) and \(z = my\) for some natural numbers \(k, m\), so \(z = (mk)x\), i.e. \(z\) is divisible by \(x\) and \((x, z) \in R\). Hence \(R\) is transitive.
Since \(R\) is reflexive and transitive but not symmetric, \(R\) is not an equivalence relation.

questions.stem:
If \(x\sqrt{1 + y} + y\sqrt{1 + x} = 0\) for \(-1 < x < 1\), then prove that :
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{1}{(1 + x)^2}\)

hi.solution:
दिया है \(x\sqrt{1 + y} + y\sqrt{1 + x} = 0\), अतः \(x\sqrt{1 + y} = -y\sqrt{1 + x}\)।
दोनों पक्षों का वर्ग करने पर:
\(x^2(1 + y) = y^2(1 + x)\)
\(x^2 - y^2 = xy^2 - x^2y = xy(y - x)\)
\((x - y)(x + y) = -xy(x - y)\)
चूँकि \(x \ne y\), अतः \(x - y\) से भाग देने पर:
\(x + y = -xy \Rightarrow y(1 + x) = -x \Rightarrow y = -\frac{x}{1 + x}\)
\(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर (भागफल नियम से):
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{(1 + x) \cdot 1 - x \cdot 1}{(1 + x)^2} = -\frac{1}{(1 + x)^2}\)
इति सिद्धम्।

\(\frac{2}{3}x^{-1/3} + \frac{2}{3}y^{-1/3}\frac{dy}{dx} = 0 \Rightarrow \frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{y^{1/3}}{x^{1/3}}\)
At the point \((1, 1)\), slope of the tangent \(= \left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)_{(1, 1)} = -1\).
Equation of the tangent at \((1, 1)\):
\(y - 1 = -1(x - 1) \Rightarrow x + y - 2 = 0\)
Slope of the normal \(= -\frac{1}{\text{slope of tangent}} = 1\).
Equation of the normal at \((1, 1)\):
\(y - 1 = 1(x - 1) \Rightarrow x - y = 0\), i.e. \(y = x\)
So the tangent is \(x + y = 2\) and the normal is \(y = x\).

questions.subtopic: Area Bounded by a Curve and a Line
questions.stem: Find the area of the region enclosed by the parabola \(y^2 = 4ax\) and its latus rectum.

hi.stem: परवलय \(y^2 = 4ax\) और उसके नाभि लम्ब से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए ।
hi.solution:
परवलय \(y^2 = 4ax\) (\(a > 0\)) की नाभि \(S(a, 0)\) है तथा नाभि लम्ब रेखा \(x = a\) है, जो परवलय को \((a, 2a)\) और \((a, -2a)\) पर काटती है। परवलय और नाभि लम्ब से घिरा क्षेत्र \(x = 0\) से \(x = a\) के बीच है तथा x-अक्ष के परितः सममित है।
ऊपरी भाग के लिये \(y = 2\sqrt{a}\sqrt{x}\)। अतः
अभीष्ट क्षेत्रफल \(= 2\int_{0}^{a} y\,dx = 2\int_{0}^{a} 2\sqrt{a}\,\sqrt{x}\,dx = 4\sqrt{a}\left[\frac{2}{3}x^{3/2}\right]_{0}^{a}\)
\(= 4\sqrt{a} \times \frac{2}{3}a^{3/2} = \frac{8a^2}{3}\)
अतः क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल \(\frac{8a^2}{3}\) वर्ग इकाई है।

questions.stem: Solve the differential equation \(y\,dx - (x + 2y^2)\,dy = 0\)

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(y\,dx - (x + 2y^2)\,dy = 0\) को हल कीजिए ।
hi.solution:
\(y\,dx - (x + 2y^2)\,dy = 0 \Rightarrow \frac{dx}{dy} = \frac{x + 2y^2}{y} \Rightarrow \frac{dx}{dy} - \frac{1}{y}x = 2y\)
यह \(\frac{dx}{dy} + P_1x = Q_1\) के रूप का रैखिक अवकल समीकरण है, जहाँ \(P_1 = -\frac{1}{y}\), \(Q_1 = 2y\)।
समाकलन गुणक \(= e^{\int -\frac{1}{y}dy} = e^{-\log y} = \frac{1}{y}\) (\(y > 0\) लेने पर)।
अतः हल है
\(x \cdot \frac{1}{y} = \int 2y \cdot \frac{1}{y}\,dy + C = \int 2\,dy + C = 2y + C\)
अतः \(x = 2y^2 + Cy\) व्यापक हल है, जहाँ \(C\) स्वेच्छ अचर है।

questions.subtopic: Graphical Solution and the Feasible Region
questions.stem: Find the maximum value of \(Z = 8x + 5y\) under the constraints \(5x + 3y \le 15\), \(2x + 5y \le 10\) and \(x \ge 0, y \ge 0\) by graphical method.

hi.stem: व्यवरोधों \(5x + 3y \le 15\), \(2x + 5y \le 10\) तथा \(x \ge 0, y \ge 0\) के अन्तर्गत \(Z = 8x + 5y\) का अधिकतम मान आलेखीय विधि से ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.solution:
Draw the lines \(5x + 3y = 15\) (through \((3, 0)\) and \((0, 5)\)) and \(2x + 5y = 10\) (through \((5, 0)\) and \((0, 2)\)). Since \((0, 0)\) satisfies both inequalities, the feasible region lies on the origin side of both lines, in the first quadrant. It is bounded, with corner points \(O(0, 0)\), \((3, 0)\), \((0, 2)\) and the intersection of the two lines.
Intersection: from \(5x + 3y = 15\) and \(2x + 5y = 10\), multiply by 5 and 3: \(25x + 15y = 75\), \(6x + 15y = 30\). Subtracting, \(19x = 45\), so \(x = \frac{45}{19}\) and \(y = \frac{10 - 2x}{5} = \frac{20}{19}\).
Values of \(Z = 8x + 5y\) at the corner points:

| Corner point | \(Z = 8x + 5y\) |
|---|---|
| \((0, 0)\) | 0 |
| \((3, 0)\) | 24 |
| \(\left(\frac{45}{19}, \frac{20}{19}\right)\) | \(\frac{360}{19} + \frac{100}{19} = \frac{460}{19}\) (maximum) |
| \((0, 2)\) | 10 |

So the maximum value of \(Z\) is \(\frac{460}{19}\) (about 24.21), at \(x = \frac{45}{19}\), \(y = \frac{20}{19}\).

questions.stem: There are three group of children having 3 girls and one boy, 2 girls and 2 boys, one girl and 3 boys respectively. One child is selected at random from each group. Find the probability that three selected children has one girl and 2 boys.

hi.stem: बच्चों के तीन समूहों में क्रमश: 3 लड़कियाँ और एक लड़का, 2 लड़कियाँ और 2 लड़के, एक लड़की और 3 लड़के हैं । प्रत्येक समूह से यादृच्छया एक बच्चा चुना जाता है । तीनों चुने गये बच्चों में एक लड़की एवं 2 लड़के होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए ।
hi.solution:
प्रत्येक समूह से लड़की (G) या लड़का चुने जाने की प्रायिकताएँ:
समूह I (3 लड़कियाँ, 1 लड़का): \(P(G_1) = \frac{3}{4}\), \(P(\bar{G_1}) = \frac{1}{4}\)
समूह II (2 लड़कियाँ, 2 लड़के): \(P(G_2) = \frac{2}{4} = \frac{1}{2}\), \(P(\bar{G_2}) = \frac{1}{2}\)
समूह III (1 लड़की, 3 लड़के): \(P(G_3) = \frac{1}{4}\), \(P(\bar{G_3}) = \frac{3}{4}\)
तीनों चयन स्वतंत्र हैं। एक लड़की और दो लड़के तीन परस्पर अपवर्जी प्रकार से चुने जा सकते हैं: लड़की समूह I, II या III से।
अभीष्ट प्रायिकता \(= P(G_1)P(\bar{G_2})P(\bar{G_3}) + P(\bar{G_1})P(G_2)P(\bar{G_3}) + P(\bar{G_1})P(\bar{G_2})P(G_3)\)
\(= \frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{4} = \frac{9}{32} + \frac{3}{32} + \frac{1}{32} = \frac{13}{32}\)
अतः अभीष्ट प्रायिकता \(\frac{13}{32}\) है।

Probabilities of selecting a girl (G) or a boy from each group:
Group I (3 girls, 1 boy): \(P(G_1) = \frac{3}{4}\), \(P(\bar{G_1}) = \frac{1}{4}\)
Group II (2 girls, 2 boys): \(P(G_2) = \frac{2}{4} = \frac{1}{2}\), \(P(\bar{G_2}) = \frac{1}{2}\)

\(= \frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{4} = \frac{9}{32} + \frac{3}{32} + \frac{1}{32} = \frac{13}{32}\)
So the probability is \(\frac{13}{32}\).

questions.subtopic: Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix
questions.stem: If \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\), then verify that \(A \cdot \text{adj}(A) = |A|\,I\) and find \(A^{-1}\).

hi.stem: यदि \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\) हो, तो सत्यापित कीजिए कि \(A \cdot \text{adj}(A) = |A|\,I\) तथा \(A^{-1}\) ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem:
Solve the following system of linear equations by matrix method :
\(x + y + z = 6\)
\(y + 3z = 11\)
\(x + z = 2y\)

hi.stem:
आव्यूह विधि से निम्न रैखिक समीकरण निकाय को हल कीजिए :
\(x + y + z = 6\)
\(y + 3z = 11\)
\(x + z = 2y\)

questions.solution:
Write the third equation as \(x - 2y + z = 0\). The system is \(AX = B\), where
\(A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 \\ 1 & -2 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), \(X = \begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{bmatrix}\), \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 6 \\ 11 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}\)
\(|A| = 1(1 + 6) - 1(0 - 3) + 1(0 - 1) = 7 + 3 - 1 = 9 \ne 0\), so \(A^{-1}\) exists and the system has a unique solution \(X = A^{-1}B\).
Cofactors:
\(A_{11} = 1 + 6 = 7\), \(A_{12} = -(0 - 3) = 3\), \(A_{13} = 0 - 1 = -1\)
\(A_{21} = -(1 + 2) = -3\), \(A_{22} = 1 - 1 = 0\), \(A_{23} = -(-2 - 1) = 3\)
\(A_{31} = 3 - 1 = 2\), \(A_{32} = -(3 - 0) = -3\), \(A_{33} = 1 - 0 = 1\)
\(\text{adj}(A) = \begin{bmatrix} 7 & -3 & 2 \\ 3 & 0 & -3 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{9}\begin{bmatrix} 7 & -3 & 2 \\ 3 & 0 & -3 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)
\(X = A^{-1}B = \frac{1}{9}\begin{bmatrix} 7 & -3 & 2 \\ 3 & 0 & -3 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 6 \\ 11 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix} = \frac{1}{9}\begin{bmatrix} 42 - 33 + 0 \\ 18 + 0 + 0 \\ -6 + 33 + 0 \end{bmatrix} = \frac{1}{9}\begin{bmatrix} 9 \\ 18 \\ 27 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}\)
So \(x = 1\), \(y = 2\), \(z = 3\).
Check: \(1 + 2 + 3 = 6\), \(2 + 9 = 11\), \(1 + 3 = 4 = 2(2)\).

questions.stem: Evaluate : \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\,dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)

hi.stem: \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\,dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।
hi.solution:
माना \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\,dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) (\(a, b > 0\))।
गुणधर्म \(\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(a - x)\,dx\) तथा \(\cos^2(\pi - x) = \cos^2 x\), \(\sin^2(\pi - x) = \sin^2 x\) से:
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x)\,dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)
\(I\) के दोनों रूपों को जोड़ने पर:
\(2I = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)
समाकल्य \(g(x) = \frac{1}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) के लिये \(g(\pi - x) = g(x)\), अतः \(\int_{0}^{\pi} g(x)\,dx = 2\int_{0}^{\pi/2} g(x)\,dx\)। अतः
\(I = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)
अंश और हर को \(\cos^2 x\) से भाग देने पर:
\(I = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sec^2 x\,dx}{a^2 + b^2\tan^2 x}\)
\(\tan x = t\) रखने पर \(\sec^2 x\,dx = dt\); जब \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) तथा जब \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t \to \infty\):
\(I = \pi\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{a^2 + b^2t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2}\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^2 + t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2} \cdot \frac{b}{a}\left[\tan^{-1}\frac{bt}{a}\right]_{0}^{\infty}\)
\(= \frac{\pi}{ab}\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 0\right) = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\)
अतः \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\,dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x} = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\)।

questions.stem:
Show that :
\(y = c_1 e^{ax}\cos bx + c_2 e^{ax}\sin bx\), where \(c_1, c_2\) are constants, is a solution of the differential equation \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 2a\frac{dy}{dx} + (a^2 - b^2)y = 0\).

hi.stem:
दिखाइए कि :
\(y = c_1 e^{ax}\cos bx + c_2 e^{ax}\sin bx\), जहाँ \(c_1, c_2\) अचर हैं, अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 2a\frac{dy}{dx} + (a^2 - b^2)y = 0\) का हल है ।
hi.solution:
**टिप्पणी:** दोनों प्रश्न-पत्रों में समीकरण \((a^2 - b^2)y\) के साथ छपा है, परन्तु दिया गया फलन NCERT के समीकरण \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 2a\frac{dy}{dx} + (a^2 + b^2)y = 0\) को संतुष्ट करता है; नीचे की गणना यही दिखाती है, अतः \((a^2 - b^2)\) के स्थान पर \((a^2 + b^2)\) होना चाहिए (मुद्रण त्रुटि)।
दिया है \(y = e^{ax}(c_1\cos bx + c_2\sin bx)\)।
\(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = ae^{ax}(c_1\cos bx + c_2\sin bx) + e^{ax}(-bc_1\sin bx + bc_2\cos bx)\)
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = ay + e^{ax}(bc_2\cos bx - bc_1\sin bx)\)
अतः \(e^{ax}(bc_2\cos bx - bc_1\sin bx) = \frac{dy}{dx} - ay\) ... (1)
पुनः अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = a\frac{dy}{dx} + ae^{ax}(bc_2\cos bx - bc_1\sin bx) + e^{ax}(-b^2c_2\sin bx - b^2c_1\cos bx)\)
\(= a\frac{dy}{dx} + a\left(\frac{dy}{dx} - ay\right) - b^2e^{ax}(c_1\cos bx + c_2\sin bx)\) ((1) से)
\(= 2a\frac{dy}{dx} - a^2y - b^2y\)
अतः \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 2a\frac{dy}{dx} + (a^2 + b^2)y = 0\)।
अतः \(y = c_1e^{ax}\cos bx + c_2e^{ax}\sin bx\), अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 2a\frac{dy}{dx} + (a^2 + b^2)y = 0\) का हल है।
छपे हुए पद के साथ \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 2a\frac{dy}{dx} + (a^2 - b^2)y = -2b^2y\), जो \(b = 0\) या \(y = 0\) के अतिरिक्त शून्य नहीं है; अतः समीकरण केवल \(+b^2\) के साथ संतुष्ट होता है।

*हल PYQ Vault द्वारा: यूपी बोर्ड उत्तर कुंजी प्रकाशित नहीं करता।*

questions.solution:
**Note:** both prints give the equation with \((a^2 - b^2)y\), but the given function satisfies the NCERT equation \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - 2a\frac{dy}{dx} + (a^2 + b^2)y = 0\); the working below shows this, so \((a^2 - b^2)\) is a misprint for \((a^2 + b^2)\).
Given \(y = e^{ax}(c_1\cos bx + c_2\sin bx)\).
Differentiating with respect to \(x\):
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = ae^{ax}(c_1\cos bx + c_2\sin bx) + e^{ax}(-bc_1\sin bx + bc_2\cos bx)\)
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = ay + e^{ax}(bc_2\cos bx - bc_1\sin bx)\)
So \(e^{ax}(bc_2\cos bx - bc_1\sin bx) = \frac{dy}{dx} - ay\) ... (1)
Differentiating again:
\(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = a\frac{dy}{dx} + ae^{ax}(bc_2\cos bx - bc_1\sin bx) + e^{ax}(-b^2c_2\sin bx - b^2c_1\cos bx)\)
\(= a\frac{dy}{dx} + a\left(\frac{dy}{dx} - ay\right) - b^2e^{ax}(c_1\cos bx + c_2\sin bx)\) (using (1))

questions.stem:
Find particular solution of differential equation
\(\frac{dy}{dx} + y\cot x = 2x + x^2\cot x, (x \ne 0)\) it is given that \(y = 0\) if \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{dy}{dx} + y\cot x = 2x + x^2\cot x, (x \ne 0)\) का विशिष्ट हल ज्ञात कीजिए, दिया है कि \(y = 0\) यदि \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\)
hi.solution:
समीकरण \(\frac{dy}{dx} + y\cot x = 2x + x^2\cot x\), \(\frac{dy}{dx} + Py = Q\) के रूप का रैखिक अवकल समीकरण है, जहाँ \(P = \cot x\), \(Q = 2x + x^2\cot x\)।
समाकलन गुणक \(= e^{\int \cot x\,dx} = e^{\log\sin x} = \sin x\)।
अतः हल है
\(y\sin x = \int (2x + x^2\cot x)\sin x\,dx + C = \int 2x\sin x\,dx + \int x^2\cos x\,dx + C\)
\(\int x^2\cos x\,dx\) का खंडशः समाकलन करने पर: \(\int x^2\cos x\,dx = x^2\sin x - \int 2x\sin x\,dx\)। अतः
\(y\sin x = \int 2x\sin x\,dx + x^2\sin x - \int 2x\sin x\,dx + C = x^2\sin x + C\)
दिया है कि \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) पर \(y = 0\):
\(0 = \frac{\pi^2}{4} \cdot 1 + C \Rightarrow C = -\frac{\pi^2}{4}\)
अतः \(y\sin x = x^2\sin x - \frac{\pi^2}{4}\), अर्थात् विशिष्ट हल है
\(y = x^2 - \frac{\pi^2}{4\sin x}\) (\(\sin x \ne 0\))।
